articles.summary: Banc of California reported Q4 2025 diluted EPS of $0.42, up 11% QoQ, and full-year diluted EPS of $1.17, with significant year-over-year growth.
articles.title: Banc of California, Inc. Reports Fourth Quarter Diluted Earnings per Share of $0.42, Up 11% Quarter over Quarter; Full Year Diluted Earnings per Share of $1.17, Significant Growth Year over Year
